captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a front stub-axle kingpin assembly. It features a long, dark rectangular beam axle with a raised central mounting block. At each end of the axle, a stub spindle pivots on a vertical kingpin joint, and each spindle supports a grey, tapered wheel hub designed for continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a front stub-axle kingpin assembly. It must include a rectangular beam axle with a central mounting block, left and right stub spindles connected via revolute kingpin joints, and left and right tapered wheel hubs mounted on continuous rotational joints.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed by defining a central rectangular beam axle with a raised block. At each end of the axle, a stub spindle is modeled using box and cylinder primitives. Finally, the wheel hubs are modeled as tapered cylinders (or combined cylindrical shapes) and attached to the spindles. Revolute joints are defined for the kingpins, and continuous rotational joints are established for the wheel hubs.
